relations.myth: Pelayo invokes Christ during his debate with Oppa
relations.note: Pelayo invokes Christ as advocate with the Father and source of rescue.
God reverses missiles, grants victory, collapses the mountain, and restores the Church.

relations.myth: Missiles rebound from Mary’s cave at Covadonga
relations.note: Pelayo shelters in Mary’s house, from which the attackers’ missiles rebound.

relations.myth: Virgin visibly appears to Pelayo at Covadonga
relations.note: Later paintings and devotional accounts depict a personal Marian apparition absent from the early chronicle.
